scenes.heading: Video from JSON.
scenes.sub: Describe the scenes. The engine draws, times and checks them.
scenes.say: This video was made from a short JSON file. Nobody drew a frame of it.
You list the scenes. Each one has a type and a few words.
Check reads the layout in a real browser and reports problems as text. Render writes the video.

scenes.heading: Seconds to render a 52 second video, by workers
scenes.say: Rendering runs in several browsers at once. These are measured on an eight core laptop.

scenes.heading: Made for language models
items: Errors that say how to fix them
A voice made on your machine
scenes.say: It is built for language models. Every error comes with its fix, and the voice you hear is made on this machine.

scenes.heading: Write JSON. Get a video.
scenes.say: Write JSON, and get a video.
